Every handler hands its work to an injected cart use case and passes callerContext the same way. The file contains no business logic or repository calls, so it does not bypass the module's use-case abstraction. Request and response shapes come from the module's own primary-adapters DTOs. The controller sits at the module root rather than under primary-adapters, but that is about where the file lives, not whether it is cohesive, so it does not fail this rule.
